Challans under Rule 167 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20-01-2026 - Authorities for disposal of Challans - Notification - Order
ORDER:
In the circumstances reported by the Transport Commissioner, Telangana in his
letter in the reference read above, the Government after careful examination hereby
decided to publish the draft Notification, as required under Rule 167 of the Central Motor
Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20th January, 2026 issued by the
Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India.
Accordingly, the following Notification shall be published in the Telangana Gazette
dated:02-06-2026.
NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-rule (5) of Rule 167 of the Central Motor
Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20th January, 2026 issued by the
Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India and in supersession of any
order inconsistent therewith, the State Government do hereby specify the following
authorities for redressal of challans issued under sub-rules (1) and (2) of Rule 167 of the said
Rules, namely:

chunks.text:
Challans under Rule 167 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20-01-2026 - Authorities for disposal of Challans - Notification - Paragraph 3 - Mode of Filing and Disposal
3. Mode of Filing and Disposal
1. All applications for contesting a challan shall be filed electronically
through the portal along with documentary evidence.
2. The Redressal Authority shall dispose of such applications by passing a
reasoned order in writing and uploaded on the portal within the time
limit prescribed under Rule 167.
3. The order so passed shall be communicated electronically to the
registered owner / licence holder.

chunks.text:
Challans under Rule 167 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, as amended vide G.S.R. 48(E) dated 20-01-2026 - Authorities for disposal of Challans - Notification - Paragraph 4 - Challan Issuance System
4. Challan Issuance System
The Transport and Police Departments shall migrate to e-challan system of
Sarathi & Vahan in a maximum period of (6) months from the date of this notification.
Thereafter all challans from Transport & Police Departments shall be issued from e-
challan system of Sarathi and Vahan (NIC). The existing challan issuance online system
will be continued only to a maximum period of Six Months from this notification.
Thereafter the system shall be migrated to e-challan system of Sarathi & Vahan
maintained by MORTH.
::3::

5. Commencement
This Notification shall come into force from the date of its publication in the
Telangana Gazette.

VIKAS RAJ

To
The Commissioner of Printing Stationery & Stores Purchase (GNS).
Chanchalguda, Hyderabad. He is requested to publish the notification in the Extra-
Ordinary Issue of Telangana Gazette, dated and send 100 Copies to Government.
The Transport Commissioner, Telangana, Hyderabad.
The Director General of Police, Telangana, Hyderabad.
The Commissioner of Police, Hyderabad.
The Commissioner of Police, Cyberabad.
The District Collector, Hyderabad.
The District Collector, Rangareddy.
The All Registering Authorities in the State (through Transport Commissioner), TG,
Hyderabad.

(Tr. Wing), New Delhi.
The Commissioner of information & Public Relations, Telangana, Hyderabad.

The OSD to Minister (Transport & BCW)
